metrics.judge_rubric_explanation: Natural spoken phrasing with courteous receptionist tone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good day! Thank you for calling Grand Canal Dental Clinic. My name is DentaCall Receptionist. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, do you have any slots on Easter Monday for a hygiene cleaning?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Grand Canal Dental Clinic is closed on public bank holidays. We are open on normal working days. Would you like to book for the next available working day?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That day is currently fully booked. I have openings available on Thursday morning at 10:00 AM with Dr. Sarah O'Connor. Would that suit you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Understood, Easter Monday is a bank holiday. Let's do the Tuesday morning at 11:00 AM.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Grand Canal Dental Clinic is closed on public bank holidays. We are open on normal working days. Would you like to book for the next available working day?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are very welcome! Take care and have a wonderful day, goodbye!
